candidates.statement: Payment service /v1/authorizations shows p95 ~4875ms; order's POST payment calls fail with ReadTimeout (~2s), propagating 502s up through order to gateway /v1/checkout. Payment latency is the bounded root cause.
candidates.uncertainty: Payment metrics show 200s at ~12/min yet traces show ReadTimeouts; exact timeout threshold and payment-side cause (CPU, GC, downstream) not established.

report.explanation: Traces show order->payment ReadTimeout errors cascading to 502s at order and gateway checkout, while inventory/redis succeed. Payment p95 latency ~4875ms supports downstream-latency as the bounded root cause; payment-side mechanism remains unconfirmed.
missing_evidence: Payment service internal latency breakdown (CPU/GC/downstream) to explain ~4875ms p95
Payment logs (excluded) to confirm timeout vs slow response
Configured client timeout value on order->payment call
